extensionDescription.message: Group tabs, show one group per window, and switch groups from a compact popup.

defaultGroupTitle.description: Default title of a new group; $1 is the smallest unused number.

actionTitle.description: Toolbar button tooltip; $1 is the title of the window's active group.

newGroup.description: Footer button that creates a group.

renameGroup.description: Rename button label; $1 is the group title.

closeGroup.description: Close button label and confirmation label; $1 is the group title.

groupNameLabel.description: Label of the inline rename field.

tabCountOne.description: Tab count for exactly one tab; $1 is the number.

tabCountOther.description: Tab count for any other number of tabs; $1 is the number.

activeElsewhere.description: Screen reader text of a group shown in another window; $1 is the tab count text.

closeGroupConfirm.description: Inline close confirmation; $1 is the group title, $2 the tab count text.

cancel.description: Button that dismisses the close confirmation.

closeGroupAction.description: Button that confirms closing a group.
